reason: The README identifies the plugin primarily as persistent memory and context support for DSH, syncing conversation turns to Honcho, recalling stored information, and injecting relevant context into sessions.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 对话自动同步到自托管 Honcho，并提供跨会话记忆、语义召回和上下文注入功能。
summaries.en: Automatically syncs DSH conversations to a self-hosted Honcho service and provides cross-session memory, semantic recall, and context injection.

capabilities: Automatically synchronizes conversation turns to a self-hosted Honcho service
Stores persistent cross-session memory and sync cursors
Performs semantic recall and injects retrieved memory into system prompts
Exposes Honcho search, session, peer, message, conclusion, and monitoring operations through tools
